workload.exact_query_policy: 32 distinct dyadic Float32 queries inserted at deterministic unique candidate indices

sampling.uncertainty_method: deterministic percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, 95% median interval
sampling.run_order: deterministic rotation of CPU Batch, sequential Prepared V2, and V4 Batch by workload, batch size, and iteration

timing_boundaries.BND-BATCH-E2E-CPU: CPU batch API entry through synchronous host result return; dataset and query validation included
timing_boundaries.BND-BATCH-E2E-V2-SEQUENTIAL-PREP: one outer interval around B sequential synchronous Prepared V2 calls with all host results available
timing_boundaries.BND-BATCH-E2E-V4: V4 batch API entry through synchronous host batch result return with one completed-batch synchronization
timing_boundaries.COST-PREP-DATASET-CONSTRUCTION: prepared V2 dataset construction; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-V2-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION: single-query V2 workspace construction; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-V4-BATCH-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION: V4 workspace construction at the reported batch capacity; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-V2-READY-CONSTRUCTION: dataset preparation plus V2 workspace construction; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-V4-BATCH-READY-CONSTRUCTION: dataset preparation plus V4 workspace construction; persistent destruction excluded

comparisons.statement: GPU V4 Batch E2E latency is lower than CPU Batch E2E latency
GPU V4 Batch E2E latency is lower than sequential Prepared V2 E2E latency

ratio_rule.all_36_rejected: at least one configuration outcome is rejected
ratio_rule.all_36_inconclusive: no configuration is rejected and at least one is inconclusive

break_even.cpu_reference_setup: zero; host dataset and queries already materialized
break_even.v2_vs_v4_setup: COST-V2-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION versus COST-V4-BATCH-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION; common prepared dataset cancels
break_even.persistent_resource_destruction: excluded; results are construction-plus-batch amortization, not complete lifetime cost

historical_evidence_policy: S7 through S13 evidence is immutable; S14 writes only to a new output directory
